title: Sentinel-2 L2A STAC-GeoParquet Mirror
description:
Item indexes for the AWS Earth Search Sentinel-2 L2A archives, as partitioned STAC-GeoParquet with MGRS-tile aggregates beside them. No STAC API sits in front, so a client queries the Parquet over HTTP range reads.

Start with `sentinel-2-c1-l2a` and `stats-c1`, which mirror Earth Search's Sentinel-2 Collection 1 index, ESA's uniform reprocessing of the archive. That pair held 30.4 million items from October 2015 onward when counted on 2026-09-22. The second pair, `sentinel-2-l2a` with `stats`, mirrors Earth Search's original index, counted at 51.25 million items on 2026-09-15. Its record begins in November 2016 and is partial before December 2018, which is what Earth Search serves rather than a gap introduced here.

The imagery stays on AWS, and each item's `assets` column carries every Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF URL verbatim. This catalog is a mirror. Earth Search, run by Element 84, produces the item indexes it republishes, and nothing here is filtered, reclassified or interpolated. Read the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) before you query.
